frozen_integrity_check.claim: Local integrity checks passed; no signed provenance or adversarial tamper guarantee.

limitations: Local consistency is not a digital signature and cannot defeat coordinated rewriting of all files.
Checks do not prove scientific claims, industrial performance, or absence of unlogged external influence.
Raw CLI stdout/stderr are not separately content-hashed by the provider; available semantic metadata is cross-checked.
An in-progress snapshot verifies existing evidence only and does not authorize holdout access.

statistical_consistency.scope: Read only saved inputs, positions and outcomes. No fitting, new data generation, retuning or modification of study evidence.
statistical_consistency.limitations: Checks numerical consistency, not independence of research decisions, authenticity of all local records, model superiority or mathematical assumptions.

limitations: Finite tests are not a proof of zero defects, security or industrial performance.
Numerical core and historical research remain unchanged; new application screening does not create coverage guarantees.
